tests.name: test_one_row_per_user_despite_timestamp_tie
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) = 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) = 4 AND MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 1 THEN order_id END) = 3 AS ok FROM latest_orders

tests.name: test_latest_means_timestamp_not_largest_id
tests.query: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 4 THEN order_id END) = 15 AS ok FROM latest_orders

tests.name: test_total_value_sums_all_lines_of_latest_order
tests.query: SELECT abs(MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 1 THEN total_value END) - 11.5) < 1e-9 AND MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 5 THEN total_value END) = 0 AS ok FROM latest_orders

tests.name: test_latest_orders_exact
tests.query: WITH a AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, order_ts, ROUND(total_value::DOUBLE, 6) FROM latest_orders), e AS (SELECT e0, e1, e2, ROUND(e3::DOUBLE, 6) FROM (VALUES (1, 3, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-03 09:00', 11.5), (2, 5, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-02 12:00', 6.0), (4, 15, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-07 10:00', 11.0), (5, 31, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-08 10:00', 0.0)) v(e0, e1, e2, e3)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM e)) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM e EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM a)) = 0 AS ok

tests.name: test_latest_orders_no_window_exact
tests.query: WITH a AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, order_ts, ROUND(total_value::DOUBLE, 6) FROM latest_orders_no_window), e AS (SELECT e0, e1, e2, ROUND(e3::DOUBLE, 6) FROM (VALUES (1, 3, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-03 09:00', 11.5), (2, 5, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-02 12:00', 6.0), (4, 15, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-07 10:00', 11.0), (5, 31, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-08 10:00', 0.0)) v(e0, e1, e2, e3)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM e)) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM e EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM a)) = 0 AS ok

tests.name: test_no_window_variant_uses_no_window_function
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) = 1 AND BOOL_AND(NOT regexp_matches(upper(sql), '\b(OVER|LATEST_ORDERS)\b')) AS ok FROM duckdb_views() WHERE view_name = 'latest_orders_no_window'

tests.name: test_prediction_grain_is_user_item
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) = 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT (user_id, item_id)) = 4 AS ok FROM latest_predictions

tests.name: test_latest_predictions_exact
tests.query: WITH a AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, prediction_id, prediction_ts, ROUND(score::DOUBLE, 6) FROM latest_predictions), e AS (SELECT e0, e1, e2, e3, ROUND(e4::DOUBLE, 6) FROM (VALUES (1, 10, 7, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-02 00:00', 0.65), (1, 11, 3, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00', 0.1), (2, 10, 4, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-05 00:00', 0.5), (2, 11, 6, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-06 00:00', NULL)) v(e0, e1, e2, e3, e4)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM e)) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM e EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM a)) = 0 AS ok
